items.title: Virginia Mayhew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2022
items.q: recently I did a rehearsal with Billy Mintz

ctx.x: Nor do I. And when I am playing with a pianist especially who uses what — I will use your term also, sort of weird chords, do you have a way of finding your way in them?

Well it depends if I have a chance to work on the stuff, which I did with Roberta’s music. So I would sit at the piano and I would play those chords and I would see what do I hear over that. And I had to do it chord by chord because there are so many of them. But I’m starting to hear them now and if I don’t have that, like recently I did a rehearsal with Billy Mintz — do you know him? A great drummer? And he has this tune, it’s really hard. Anyhow, it’s just really hard tune — and he said, “Don’t look at the…
Well I find that I probably avoid the situations.
